report.summary: daedalus/spine/attempt.py: Provides TaskAttempt, the crash-safe seam between intent and candidate patch, with fenced git calls and no write path to the primary checkout.
risks: WRITES|daedalus/spine/attempt.py|git branch refs in primary repo
READS|daedalus/spine/attempt.py|primary checkout via read-only git verbs
CLAIMS|daedalus/spine/attempt.py|crash-safe and cannot write to the developer's working tree
CLAIMS|daedalus/spine/attempt.py|single git choke point via _git function
CLAIMS|daedalus/spine/attempt.py|runner is never told where the repo is (no repo_root in RunnerContext)
CLAIMS|daedalus/spine/attempt.py|no apply path exists: deliverable is inert PatchArtifact bytes
